searchText: I'm having a hard time understanding what `EXTCODESIZE` returns on an EOA using 7702. Is it `0` or the size of the contract being loaded? It returns 23 (prefix + delegate address length) would expect 35, for address space extension is it rlp nope Nothing has been settled for address space expansion. I expect special handling for 20 byte addresses forever TBH. But clients should keep in mind that length may change. This is a possiblre reason to make EXTCODEADDESS available in legacy and not jsut EOF as it ansewers the question in a manner compatible with future upgrades. Longer addresses will have a different prefix, probably
